mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 3.5% over the past three months signals tightening labor market conditions, increasing wage pressures and corporate profit margins, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals weakening supply-side capacity, which reduces inflationary pressure and allows the Federal Reserve to delay rate hikes, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal produces negative returns in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a flattening or inversion of the yield curve (implied by stable CPIAUCSL) signals a monetary tightening cycle that reduces speculative demand for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL is stable (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO), signals weakening aggregate demand, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 12mo MA and INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals strong labor market momentum that increases corporate hiring costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 3.6% (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized over the past four quarters signals a weakening economy, which increases the likelihood of a Fed rate cut, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 < 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails in more than 60% of triggered instances.
